description: Shemaroo Entertainment Limited engages in the distribution of content for broadcasting of satellite channels and digital technologies in India. The company offers a portfolio of content, including films, television shows, comedy, devotional programming, music, regional entertainment, and children's content. It also operates ShemarooMe, a video over the top (OTT) platform. In addition, the company provides DTH, music, studio, and film production services, as well as in-flight entertainment solutions. It distributes its content to domestic satellite, cable, and terrestrial platforms. The company was founded in 1962 and is based in Mumbai, India.
